subject.title: feat(telegram): open the dashboard in a Telegram Mini App

question: Should OpenClaw accept Telegram Mini App dashboard auth by allowing control-ui bootstrap handoff credentials from the Telegram plugin once the security and base-path blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR crosses the Telegram plugin, public SDK exports, Gateway auth, and Control UI bootstrap boundary, so the permanent trust model needs maintainer intent in addition to code fixes.

options.title: Fix and prove the Mini App path
options.body: Require the security and base-path fixes plus redacted live Telegram proof before considering merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer the auth seam
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a smaller plugin/core API design before adding silent Control UI bootstrap handoff.

options.title: Close as out of core scope
options.body: Reject the feature if maintainers want Telegram dashboard launching to live outside bundled OpenClaw surfaces for now.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove the Mini App path
recommendation.body: Require the security and base-path fixes plus redacted live Telegram proof before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history points to Peter Steinberger across the gateway/UI/Telegram surfaces most affected by this decision.
